"""Task-local raw command capture; no source patching or test substitution."""
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, json, os, resource, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('name');p.add_argument('--cwd',default=str(R/'source'));p.add_argument('--timeout',type=int,default=120);p.add_argument('argv',nargs=argparse.REMAINDER);a=p.parse_args()
argv=a.argv[1:] if a.argv[:1]==['--'] else a.argv
out=R/'output'/a.name;out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env={'PATH':'/opt/pyvenv/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin','HOME':str(R),'LANG':'C','LC_ALL':'C','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
manifest=json.loads((R/'MATERIALIZED-SOURCE.json').read_text())
def identities():
    rows={}
    for n,x in manifest.items():
        b=(R/n).read_bytes();h=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()
        if h!=x['git_blob']:raise RuntimeError('changed exact source:'+n)
        rows[n]=dict(bytes=len(b),git_blob=h,sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
    return rows
before=identities();start=time.time_ns();mono=time.monotonic();ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
record=dict(schema='DD1-NEW-COMMAND-CAPTURE-1',status='NEW_EXECUTION_NOT_RECOVERY',argv=argv,cwd=a.cwd,environment=env,start_ns=start,start_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),source_before=before,stdout_path='stdout.bin',stderr_path='stderr.bin')
(out/'START.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
with (out/'stdout.bin').open('xb') as stdout,(out/'stderr.bin').open('xb') as stderr:
    try:
        proc=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=a.cwd,env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,timeout=a.timeout)
        record['exit']=proc.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        record['exit']=None;record['capture_error']='TimeoutExpired';raise
    finally:
        final=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
        record.update(end_ns=time.time_ns(),wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-mono,child_user_seconds=final.ru_utime-ru.ru_utime,child_system_seconds=final.ru_stime-ru.ru_stime,child_maxrss_kib=final.ru_maxrss,source_after=identities())
        for f in (stdout,stderr):f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
        for n in ('stdout','stderr'):
            b=(out/(n+'.bin')).read_bytes();record[n]=b.decode('utf-8',errors='strict');record[n+'_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();record[n+'_bytes']=len(b)
        (out/'COMMAND.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ('argv','exit','wall_seconds','child_user_seconds','child_system_seconds','stdout','stderr')},indent=2))
